column3: 8. What is the win-loss ratio for teams batting second in matches where a required run rate of over 4.0 runs per over was needed after the 10th over?
column4:
WITH RequiredRunRate AS (
    SELECT
        r.fixture_id,
        r.score AS total_runs,
        CAST(r.score AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(CAST(r.overs AS FLOAT), 0) AS run_rate
    FROM history2.fixtures__runs r
    WHERE r.inning = 2 AND r.overs > 10
),
Matches AS (
    SELECT
        r.fixture_id,
        r.total_runs,
        r.run_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN r.total_runs > (
                SELECT TOP 1 r1.score
                FROM history2.fixtures__runs r1
                WHERE r1.fixture_id = r.fixture_id AND r1.inning = 1
                ORDER BY r1.fixture_id DESC
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_win
    FROM RequiredRunRate r
)
SELECT
    SUM(is_win) AS total_wins,
    COUNT(*) - SUM(is_win) AS total_losses,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(is_win) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
        ELSE 0
    END AS win_loss_ratio
FROM Matches;

column3: 8. Compare KKR's batting statistics in the last five overs when the required run rate is 3.0 versus when it exceeds 10.0.
column4:
WITH RequiredRunRate AS (
    SELECT b.fixture_id, b.score__runs, b.ball,
           CAST(SUM(b.score__runs) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(b.ball), 0) AS run_rate
    FROM history2.fixtures__balls b
    WHERE b.scoreboard = 'S2' AND 
          b.batsman__fullname LIKE '%Kolkata Knight Riders%'
          AND (b.ball >= (SELECT MAX(ball) FROM history2.fixtures__balls WHERE scoreboard = 'S2' AND batsman__fullname LIKE '%Kolkata Knight Riders%') - 30) 
    GROUP BY b.fixture_id, b.ball
),
Statistics AS (
    SELECT r.fixture_id,
           SUM(b.score__runs) AS total_runs,
           COUNT(*) AS total_balls,
           CAST(SUM(b.score__runs) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(b.ball), 0) AS current_run_rate
    FROM history2.fixtures__balls b
    JOIN RequiredRunRate r ON b.fixture_id = r.fixture_id
    WHERE b.ball >= (SELECT MAX(ball) - 30 FROM history2.fixtures__balls WHERE scoreboard = 'S2')
    GROUP BY r.fixture_id
)
SELECT *, 
       CASE 
           WHEN current_run_rate <= 3.0 THEN 'Run Rate <= 3.0'
           WHEN current_run_rate > 10.0 THEN 'Run Rate > 10.0'
           ELSE 'Between'
       END AS run_rate_category
FROM Statistics;
